items.q: How old do you have to be to use Lady L's Wood-Ridge cannabis delivery?

items.q: What ID is accepted for cannabis delivery in Wood-Ridge?

items.q: Do I need a medical cannabis card to use Lady L's delivery service?
items.a_html: Not at all. Lady L operates as an adult-use dispensary, which means any customer 21 or older can place a delivery order without a medical card. A valid ID and a confirmed Lady L account are all that's required.

items.q: How much cannabis can I receive in a single Wood-Ridge delivery order?
items.a_html:
New Jersey law allows us to sell up to the equivalent of 28.35 grams (1 ounce) of usable cannabis per transaction. Here's how that breaks down by product type:

  • Dried Flower/Bud: 28.35 grams (1 ounce).
  • Concentrates/Resin/Oils: 4 grams (solid or liquid/vaporized oil).
  • Ingestible Items (Gummies/Edibles): 1,000 mg of THC (roughly ten 100mg packages).
  • Maximum Possession Limit: Up to 6 ounces of cannabis and cannabis products.
  • Mixing Products: You can mix and match, for example, by purchasing 1/2 ounce of flower and 2 grams of concentrates.
  • Daily Limits: The 1-ounce limit is generally considered a daily limit across all dispensaries.

items.q: What taxes apply when you order cannabis delivery in New Jersey?
items.a_html: Adult-use cannabis purchases in New Jersey include a 6.625% state sales tax, a 2% municipal transfer or user tax where applicable, and a $2.50-per-ounce Social Equity Excise Fee (SEEF). These taxes apply to delivery orders just as they do to in-store purchases. All applicable charges are shown at checkout before you confirm.
